source_description: Photogrammetry of a historic house facade on Rue de Flandre / Vlaamsesteenweg in Brussels. Zenodo describes a house dating to the 14th century whose facade was petrified/reworked in the first half of the 17th century.

evidence: Brussels architectural inventory lists Rue de Flandre 180 as a protected traditional house.
Published archaeological literature specifically reports medieval/early-modern brick evidence and 17th-century facade petrification at 180 Rue de Flandre.
The wording and chronology closely match the ArcheoBru model description, but no source metadata inspected so far explicitly states house number 180.
